title: VS Code Projects Dock
shortDescription: Your pinned and open VS Code projects as a side-by-side strip in the PowerToys Command Palette dock.
description:
VS Code Projects Dock shows your VS Code projects as a strip in the PowerToys Command Palette dock - pinned projects and open windows, side by side.

Click a project to focus its window if it is already open, or launch it if it is closed. Pinned projects stay on the left so favourites are one click away; open windows appear on the right and clear when you close them. Local and WSL-remote projects work the same way.

What you need:
- Microsoft PowerToys with the Command Palette feature enabled.
- The free companion extension 'VS Code Projects Dock (Companion)' from the Visual Studio Marketplace, which reports your open windows to the dock.

Privacy: the companion writes only a small local state file under your user profile. Nothing is sent over the network.
